decisions.reason: As an organic line extension very close to our core ham business and to our stated strategy of expanding organic products, we are likely to persist with it despite limited visible evidence on later results.

This organic sliced cured product fits our existing capabilities and public organic positioning, so sunk certification and launch effort make management inclined to continue unless failure is unmistakable.

The organic pepper salami is an incremental variant within our established salami range, and escalation of commitment supports keeping such a strategically aligned extension when outcomes remain ambiguous.
The teriyaki aspic beef specialty looks more like a niche experiment outside the firm's main announced direction, with less reputational and strategic commitment, so it is easier to discontinue.
Its dedicated page suggests somewhat stronger public commitment than a routine launch mention, which makes management more willing to justify staying with this close-to-core salami variant.

Although public commitment appears limited, this pâté variant remains close to our traditional premium deli offer, so management is still slightly more likely to retain it than to admit the launch was a mistake.
